corrections.claim: 2608 valid M16 windows are certified geometry
corrections.correction: Numerical fit validity and complete certificate-bound geometry eligibility are distinct. The 99.05 percent yield is valid per source-timing-supported, not independently certified physical coverage.

corrections.claim: All optional geometry present means a single undivided epoch
corrections.correction: Availability can span explicit topology resets. A single compound epoch is a separate condition.

corrections.claim: Joint geometry and motion uncertainty is ready for formal calibration
corrections.correction: Covariance propagation remains conditional; phase, identity, topology and some input cross-covariances are excluded. No independent coverage calibration is established.

corrections.claim: Centroid oracle proves only a few pixels of causal endpoint error
corrections.correction: The oracle uses target information. Its gain identifies positional sensitivity on its cohort, but does not establish a causal solution, absolute error scale, or independently correct velocity.

corrections.claim: Track 2 candidates have not been implemented
corrections.correction: Bounded Koopman, recurrent/MLP, actual IMM, and optional geometry-input ablations already exist. Preserve these as historical exploratory evidence and hold new development.
P08 and P18 were excluded from fitting but repeatedly used for evaluation. They are training-held-out, not fresh final participants.

corrections.claim: 5-10 new participants resolve finite 95 percent participant calibration
corrections.correction: Under the previous split-conformal rank construction, at least 19 independent exchangeable calibration units are needed for a finite 95 percent rank. They must be valid calibration units, not fitting subjects or overlapping windows; this numerical minimum does not establish exchangeability.
